summary: Climber fell several hundred feet after a boulder gave way while ascending the northwest ridge approach near the summit of Mt. Lindsey; AVSAR contacted the morning of June 5; injury severity and weather required helicopter extraction; REACH 71 flew the climber out at ~1:40 p.m.
location: Mt. Lindsey (northwest ridge approach near summit)
responding_agency: AVSAR, REACH 71 helicopter, Costilla County Sheriff's Office
